message:
The other night, we had an unexpected blackout that turned into a little adventure! As the lights flickered out, I grabbed my trusty flashlight and set up a cozy little nook with blankets and snacks. We charged our phones using a power bank and pulled out a lantern for some soft light, turning the living room into our own version of a camping trip. 

Instead of worrying about the power being out, we shared stories and played some card games by lantern light. It was a sweet reminder that sometimes, the best memories come from the unplanned moments. 

Have you ever turned a blackout into a cozy gathering? I’d love to hear your tips or tricks!
